newsitem.title: ITALY: Specialists bid for three bln lire of Italy CCTs.
newsitem.headline: Specialists bid for three bln lire of Italy CCTs.

text.p: Specialist bond traders bid for and were allocated three billion lire of seven-year variable-rate certificates (CCT) against the Italian Treasury's offer of 250 billion lire of paper.
Earlier, the Treasury received bids for 4.644 trillion lire at the open auction for the November 1, 2003 paper, against 2.5 trillion lire worth of certificates on offer.
The auction price was set at 100.95 from 101.35 at the previous CCT sale on November 15. Gross yield was 7.07 percent against 7.19 percent.
